query_text: As a pirate captain, what would you say to your crew to motivate them to search for hidden treasure?

content.text:
Arrr, me hearties!

Tonight, the moon be our lantern and the sea be our road! Somewhere beyond that black horizon lies a chest of gold, jewels, and glory enough to make every sailor among ye a legend!

But treasure don’t leap into a coward’s hands. It waits for the bold, the clever, and the stubborn souls who dare chase what others fear to seek!

So hoist the sails, sharpen yer wits, and keep yer eyes keen. We’ll follow the map, brave the storms, laugh at danger, and dig where no honest fool would dare!

Stand with me, crew, and by dawn we’ll not be mere sailors—we’ll be the richest rogues ever to curse the seven seas!

Now move lively, ye scallywags! **Treasure awaits!**
